$comment: 环境变量文档单一事实源：改这里后执行 npm run docs:env 再提交；CI 用 npm run check:docs 校验。

rows.name: `MODE`
rows.desc: `both` / `http` / `stdio`. `http` enables Streamable HTTP + SSE.

rows.name: `HOST` / `OPEN_WEBSEARCH_HOST`
rows.desc: MCP HTTP bind address. Binding to a non-loopback address also registers that host in the Host allowlist and prints a no-auth warning.

rows.name: `PORT`
rows.desc: MCP HTTP port

rows.name: `OPEN_WEBSEARCH_ALLOWED_HOSTS`
rows.desc: Extra Host-header allowlist entries (comma-separated), needed when serving through a public domain/reverse proxy

rows.name: `OPEN_WEBSEARCH_DAEMON_HOST` / `OPEN_WEBSEARCH_DAEMON_PORT`
rows.desc: Local REST daemon bind address (no auth: keep it on loopback)

rows.name: `METRICS_ENABLED`
rows.desc: Enables in-process counters and the daemon `/metrics` endpoint

rows.name: `FETCH_WEB_DEADLINE_MS`
rows.desc: Hard deadline for one `fetchWebContent` call (cookie + browser + retries combined)

rows.name: `GITHUB_CONTENT_CDN_FIRST`
rows.desc: Prefer jsDelivr over `raw.githubusercontent.com` for **README and source files** (public repos only). Legacy alias `GITHUB_README_CDN_FIRST` still works.

rows.name: `GITHUB_CONTENT_BUDGET_MS`
rows.desc: Total time budget for one `fetchGithubContent` call; per-attempt timeout is capped at 4.5s.

rows.name: `BING_PLAYWRIGHT_BUDGET_MS`
rows.desc: Legacy name retained for compatibility: budget for the Bing browser fallback (now backed by raw CDP) before HTTP results are kept

rows.name: `MYWEBSEARCH_NO_AUTO_BOOTSTRAP`
rows.desc: Set to `1` to stop copying API keys out of other apps' MCP configs on first run

rows.name: `DEFAULT_SEARCH_ENGINE`
rows.desc: Default engine: `auto` (smart query routing: Chinese `baidu,sogou`, English/foreign `bing,duckduckgo`). Supports all 16 engines: `auto`, `bing`, `bing-news`, `baidu`, `sogou`, `duckduckgo`, `brave`, `csdn`, `juejin`, `startpage`, `yahoo`, `exa`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `hackernews`, `arxiv`, `code` (vertical developer engines can be configured as default, though `auto` or general web engines are recommended for global default)

rows.name: `ALLOWED_SEARCH_ENGINES`
rows.desc: Comma-separated whitelist of allowed search engines (e.g. `bing,baidu,duckduckgo`)

rows.name: `BING_BASE_URL`
rows.desc: Base URL for Bing queries. Overseas users or reverse proxy nodes can set to `https://www.bing.com/search` (legacy alias `OPEN_WEBSEARCH_BING_HOST` supported)

rows.name: `DEFAULT_MIN_RESULTS`
rows.desc: Cascade threshold: triggers fallback engines when usable results are fewer than this value

rows.name: `DEFAULT_SEARCH_LIMIT`
rows.desc: Default result limit when not explicitly specified in tool calls (max 50)

rows.name: `SEARCH_DEADLINE_MS`
rows.desc: Global hard deadline for multi-engine search execution (milliseconds)

rows.name: `SEARCH_FUSION`
rows.desc: Result fusion mode: `legacy` (engine-hit count + arrival order) or `rrf` (Reciprocal Rank Fusion over per-engine ranks, which also replaces the position/consensus terms in re-ranking). RRF stays opt-in until a larger evaluation exists.

rows.name: `SEARCH_FUSION_RRF_K`
rows.desc: RRF constant k; lower values amplify rank differences. Only used when `SEARCH_FUSION=rrf`.

rows.name: `ENGINE_CIRCUIT_BASE_COOLDOWN_MS`
rows.desc: First circuit-breaker cooldown for an engine (429 / 202 / bot_challenge). Repeated failures back off exponentially (30s → 60s → 120s…). Brave overrides the first step to **60s** because its 429 is a rolling 60-second window of 6 requests (the 7th is challenged) and recovery only starts once the oldest request ages out; setting this variable explicitly disables the per-engine override.

rows.name: `ENGINE_CIRCUIT_MAX_COOLDOWN_MS`
rows.desc: Upper bound for the exponential circuit-breaker backoff (default 5 minutes).

rows.name: `SEARCH_AUTHORITY_DOMAINS`
rows.desc: Additional authority domain whitelist for result re-ranking (comma-separated, appended to built-in list)

rows.name: `SEARCH_MODE`
rows.desc:
Search mode and browser policy. Supports single mode, multi-engine per mode, and compound multi-mode combinations:
• **Global mode**: `auto` (default fallback), `request`/`none` (pure HTTP), `playwright` (force browser; legacy value name, now backed by CDP)
• **Single mode, multiple engines**: `playwright:bing,startpage`, `auto:bing,startpage`, `bing,startpage`
• **Compound multiple modes**: `playwright:bing;auto:startpage` (bing forces browser, startpage uses auto fallback), `auto;request:startpage` (global auto but startpage uses pure HTTP)

rows.name: `BRAVE_BROWSER_FALLBACK`
rows.desc: When the keyless Brave web path returns HTTP 429 / an anti-bot challenge, retry once through a disguised desktop headless CDP browser that auto-triggers the Argon2 PoW `验证` button (`1` enabled, `0` disables and fails fast). A 429 then opens a **180 s browser-only window**: HTTP is skipped and every Brave call in the window goes straight to the browser; if that also fails the engine trips its circuit (60 → 120 → 240 → 300 s) and routing/cascade substitute other engines. Measured 8/8 success at ~4–6s per query while plain HTTP stayed 429. Still best-effort: it cannot pass the interactive slider CAPTCHA

rows.name: `AUTO_ROUTE_EN_ENGINES`
rows.desc: Comma-separated engines for default English auto-routing

rows.name: `AUTO_ROUTE_ZH_ENGINES`
rows.desc: Comma-separated engines for default Chinese auto-routing

rows.name: `PROXY_URL`
rows.desc:
Consolidated upstream proxy configuration (merges previous `USE_PROXY` and `PROXY_ENGINES`). Not needed in TUN mode.
• **Default proxy**: passing empty `PROXY_URL=""` or `PROXY_URL=true` activates default `http://127.0.0.1:7897` (common local proxy ports include 7897, 7890, 10809; overseas engines use proxy, domestic engines stay direct)
• **Custom address**: `PROXY_URL=http://127.0.0.1:10809`
• **Custom engines**: `PROXY_URL="http://127.0.0.1:7897;duckduckgo,brave"` or all engines `PROXY_URL=";all"`

rows.name: `FAKE_IP_CIDRS`
rows.desc: Whitelisted CIDRs for Fake-IP / TUN mode to avoid SSRF false-positive blocking

rows.name: `CUSTOM_DNS_SERVERS`
rows.desc: Comma-separated DNS servers used by the internal c-ares resolver (helps when the system DNS is polluted). Overrides the built-in list entirely

rows.name: `IMPERSONATE_BROWSER`
rows.desc: `wreq-js` browser TLS/H2 fingerprint profile (e.g. `chrome_149`, `safari_18`)

rows.name: `IMPERSONATE_OS`
rows.desc: Operating system platform for fingerprint impersonation (`windows`, `macos`, `linux`)

rows.name: `BING_IMPERSONATE`
rows.desc: Toggle Chrome TLS impersonation for Bing HTTP mode (auto-trips circuit breaker after consecutive empty results)

rows.name: `ANUBIS_MAX_POW_DIFFICULTY`
rows.desc: Maximum difficulty threshold for Startpage Anubis PoW solver; skips/falls back when difficulty exceeds this

rows.name: `DIRECT_FIRST_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS`
rows.desc: Timeout in ms for direct-first connection probes before proxy fallback

rows.name: `FETCH_WEB_INSECURE_TLS`
rows.desc: Disable TLS certificate verification for `fetchWebContent` only (for broken legacy site certs)

rows.name: `GITHUB_README_CDN_FIRST`
rows.desc: When `true`, forces skipping `raw.githubusercontent.com` direct probe and queries jsDelivr CDN first (domestic network acceleration)

rows.name: `CONTEXT7_API_KEY`
rows.desc: [Context7 API Key](https://context7.com/dashboard) (strongly recommended for proxy/TUN users to avoid shared IP quotas)

rows.name: `EXA_API_KEY`
rows.desc: [Exa Free API Key](https://dashboard.exa.ai/api-keys) (only required if using the `exa` semantic search engine)

rows.name: `BRAVE_API_KEY`
rows.desc: [Brave Search API Key](https://api.search.brave.com/app/keys) (optional; uses official high-reliability API when set)

rows.name: `GITHUB_TOKEN`
rows.desc: [GitHub Personal Access Token](https://github.com/settings/tokens) (optional; raises rate limit to 5,000 req/hr)

rows.name: `GITEE_TOKEN`
rows.desc: [Gitee Personal Access Token](https://gitee.com/profile/personal_access_tokens) (optional; raises Gitee API rate limits and enables private repos)

rows.name: `STACKOVERFLOW_API_KEY`
rows.desc: [Stack Apps Key](https://stackapps.com/apps/oauth/register) (optional; raises quota to 10,000 req/day)

rows.name: `MODE`
rows.desc: MCP transport mode: `stdio` (stdin/stdout only), `http` (HTTP/SSE only), `both` (concurrent)

rows.name: `PORT`
rows.desc: MCP HTTP/SSE listen port (local persistent daemon uses `3210` by default)

rows.name: `MAX_CONCURRENT_SEARCHES`
rows.desc: Max concurrent searches in daemon mode (`0` for unlimited)

rows.name: `MCP_MAX_SESSIONS`
rows.desc: Max retained MCP HTTP sessions before returning HTTP 429 Too Many Requests

rows.name: `MCP_SESSION_TTL_MS`
rows.desc: Idle session expiration duration before reaping (default 30 min)

rows.name: `MCP_SESSION_REAPER_MS`
rows.desc: Session reaper scan interval (default 5 min)

rows.name: `LOG_LEVEL`
rows.desc: Log level: `quiet` (completely silent), `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`

rows.name: `SECURITY_AUDIT`
rows.desc: Enable SSRF blocking and host header security audit logging

rows.name: `OPEN_WEBSEARCH_ALLOWED_HOSTS`
rows.desc: Host header whitelist for HTTP server (DNS Rebinding protection, comma-separated)

en.title: 🧭 CDP Browser & Stealth Controls (legacy Playwright env names kept)

rows.name: `BROWSER_DRIVER`
rows.desc: Browser backend. `cdp` (default, raw CDP). `playwright` is a legacy escape hatch and requires you to install `playwright-core` manually; it is no longer bundled.

rows.name: `BROWSER_PROFILE`
rows.desc: CDP device profile: `off`, `windows-chrome-8`, `windows-chrome-16`, `macos-chrome-8`, or `random`. Applies UA, screen/DPR, timezone and locale to browser sessions. It does not affect HTTP-only engines such as DuckDuckGo/Brave.

rows.name: `DDG_BROWSER_FALLBACK`
rows.desc: When DuckDuckGo's HTTP paths return 202/CAPTCHA, retry the HTML endpoint through the CDP browser. Uses `BROWSER_PROFILE` when set, otherwise the coherent `windows-chrome-8` default; set `0` to disable.

rows.name: `PLAYWRIGHT_CDP_ENDPOINT`
rows.desc: Remote Chrome/Edge CDP endpoint URL (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:9222` or `ws://...`); legacy name, used by the CDP driver

rows.name: `PLAYWRIGHT_EXECUTABLE_PATH`
rows.desc: Absolute path to a **Chromium-based** browser executable. Auto-detection covers Chrome / Edge / Chromium / Brave / Vivaldi / Opera in standard locations; `CHROME_PATH` and `BROWSER_PATH` are checked first and work as equivalents; legacy name

rows.name: `PLAYWRIGHT_HEADLESS`
rows.desc: Run headless (on Windows, an isolated hidden desktop window is used); legacy name

rows.name: `PLAYWRIGHT_NAVIGATION_TIMEOUT_MS`
rows.desc: Hard page navigation timeout (milliseconds); legacy name, applied to CDP navigation

rows.name: `MYWEBSEARCH_DATA_DIR`
rows.desc: Root directory for configuration and persistent cookie files

rows.name: `OPEN_WEBSEARCH_RESPONSE_CAP_BYTES`
rows.desc: Maximum character limit returned to LLMs to prevent prompt context explosion

rows.name: `MCP_TOOL_SEARCH_NAME`
rows.desc: Custom registration name for the search tool in MCP

rows.name: `MCP_TOOL_FETCH_WEB_NAME`
rows.desc: Custom registration name for the content extraction tool

rows.name: `MCP_TOOL_FETCH_GITHUB_NAME`
rows.desc: Custom registration name for the GitHub/Gitee content tool (set to `fetchGithubReadme` for backward compatibility)

rows.name: `HOST` / `OPEN_WEBSEARCH_HOST`
rows.desc: MCP HTTP 监听地址；绑定到非回环地址时会自动加入 Host 白名单并打印无鉴权警告

rows.name: `OPEN_WEBSEARCH_DAEMON_HOST` / `OPEN_WEBSEARCH_DAEMON_PORT`
rows.desc: 本地 REST daemon 监听地址（无鉴权，保持回环）

rows.name: `METRICS_ENABLED`
rows.desc: 启用进程内计数器与 daemon `/metrics` 端点

rows.name: `FETCH_WEB_DEADLINE_MS`
rows.desc: 单次 `fetchWebContent` 的硬截止时间（cookie + 浏览器 + 重试合计）

rows.name: `BING_PLAYWRIGHT_BUDGET_MS`
rows.desc: 旧变量名保留：Bing 浏览器兜底预算（现由 raw CDP 驱动），超时后保留 HTTP 结果

rows.name: `MYWEBSEARCH_NO_AUTO_BOOTSTRAP`
rows.desc: 设为 `1` 时，首次运行不再从其他应用的 MCP 配置中复制 API Key

rows.name: `DEFAULT_SEARCH_ENGINE`
rows.desc: 默认搜索引擎。`auto`（智能感知路由：中文走 `baidu,sogou`，英文走 `bing,duckduckgo`）。支持全部 16 个引擎：`auto`、`bing`、`bing-news`、`baidu`、`sogou`、`duckduckgo`、`brave`、`csdn`、`juejin`、`startpage`、`yahoo`、`exa`、`github`、`stackoverflow`、`hackernews`、`arxiv`、`code`（垂直开发者引擎可配置为默认，全局默认推荐保持 `auto` 或通用网页引擎）

rows.name: `ALLOWED_SEARCH_ENGINES`
rows.desc: 限制启用的引擎白名单（逗号分隔，如 `bing,baidu,duckduckgo`）

rows.name: `BING_BASE_URL`
rows.desc: Bing 搜索请求基址。国际用户可改为 `https://www.bing.com/search` 或自定义中转域名（兼容旧变量 `OPEN_WEBSEARCH_BING_HOST`）

rows.name: `DEFAULT_MIN_RESULTS`
rows.desc: 级联补位阈值：可用结果数不足该值时，自动调度备用引擎补齐

rows.name: `DEFAULT_SEARCH_LIMIT`
rows.desc: 工具调用未显式传 `limit` 时的单次返回上限（最大 50）

rows.name: `SEARCH_DEADLINE_MS`
rows.desc: 搜索任务全局超时硬预算（毫秒）

rows.name: `SEARCH_FUSION`
rows.desc: 结果融合模式：`legacy`（命中引擎数 + 到达顺序）或 `rrf`（按各引擎内排名做 Reciprocal Rank Fusion，并在重排阶段替换 position/consensus 两项）。RRF 默认关闭，等待更大评测集。

rows.name: `SEARCH_FUSION_RRF_K`
rows.desc: RRF 常数 k，越小越放大排名差异；仅 `SEARCH_FUSION=rrf` 时生效。

rows.name: `GITHUB_CONTENT_CDN_FIRST`
rows.desc: README 与源码文件优先走 jsDelivr（仅公开仓库）；旧名 `GITHUB_README_CDN_FIRST` 仍兼容。

rows.name: `GITHUB_CONTENT_BUDGET_MS`
rows.desc: 单次 `fetchGithubContent` 的总时间预算；单次尝试上限 4.5s。

rows.name: `ENGINE_CIRCUIT_BASE_COOLDOWN_MS`
rows.desc: 引擎首次熔断冷却（429 / 202 / 验证状态）。连续失败指数退避（30s → 60s → 120s…）。Brave 的首档被覆盖为 **60s**（其 429 是「滚动 60 秒内 6 个请求」的窗口，第 7 个触发，且要等最早请求滑出窗口才恢复）；显式设置该变量会关闭按引擎覆盖。

rows.name: `ENGINE_CIRCUIT_MAX_COOLDOWN_MS`
rows.desc: 熔断指数退避上限（默认 5 分钟）。

rows.name: `SEARCH_AUTHORITY_DOMAINS`
rows.desc: 结果重排的额外权威域名白名单（逗号分隔，追加到内置白名单）

rows.name: `SEARCH_MODE`
rows.desc:
检索模式与浏览器启动策略。支持单模式、一种方式多选引擎、以及多启动方式组合：
• **全局模式**：`auto`（默认允许兜底）、`request`/`none`（全纯HTTP防爆内存）、`playwright`（全强走浏览器；旧值名，底层为 CDP）
• **一种方式多选引擎**：`playwright:bing,startpage`、`auto:bing,startpage`、`bing,startpage`
• **多选启动方式组合**：`playwright:bing;auto:startpage`（bing强走渲染，startpage走自动兜底）、`auto;request:startpage`（全局auto但startpage走纯HTTP）

rows.name: `BRAVE_BROWSER_FALLBACK`
rows.desc: Brave 无 Key 网页路径返回 HTTP 429 / 人机挑战时，是否用桌面指纹伪装的无头 CDP 浏览器重试一次，并自动点击 Argon2 PoW「验证」按钮（`1` 启用，`0` 关闭并快速失败）。命中 429 后会打开 **180 秒的「浏览器优先」窗口**：窗口内跳过 HTTP、所有 Brave 调用直接走浏览器；若浏览器也失败则升级为熔断（60 → 120 → 240 → 300 秒），由路由/级联换引擎。实测在 HTTP 持续 429 期间 8/8 成功、每次约 4–6s。仍是 best-effort：无法通过交互式滑块验证

rows.name: `AUTO_ROUTE_EN_ENGINES`
rows.desc: 英文查询默认自动路由引擎列表（逗号分隔）

rows.name: `AUTO_ROUTE_ZH_ENGINES`
rows.desc: 中文查询默认自动路由引擎列表（逗号分隔）

rows.name: `PROXY_URL`
rows.desc:
统一上游代理配置（已合并原 `USE_PROXY` 与 `PROXY_ENGINES`，TUN 模式无需配置保持直连）。
• **开启默认代理**：传空值 `PROXY_URL=""` 或 `PROXY_URL=true` 即可启用默认 `http://127.0.0.1:7897`（常见本地代理端口如 7897、7890、10809；默认仅国际引擎走代理，国内引擎直连）
• **自定义地址**：`PROXY_URL=http://127.0.0.1:10809`
• **自选引擎**：`PROXY_URL="http://127.0.0.1:7897;duckduckgo,brave"` 或全部引擎走代理 `PROXY_URL=";all"`

rows.name: `FAKE_IP_CIDRS`
rows.desc: Fake-IP 虚拟网段白名单，避免误触发 SSRF 本地私网地址拦截

rows.name: `CUSTOM_DNS_SERVERS`
rows.desc: 内部 c-ares 解析器使用的 DNS 服务器（逗号分隔），系统 DNS 被污染时可用；会整体替换内置列表

rows.name: `IMPERSONATE_BROWSER`
rows.desc: `wreq-js` 模拟的现代浏览器 TLS/H2 指纹（如 `chrome_149`, `safari_18`）

rows.name: `IMPERSONATE_OS`
rows.desc: 指纹模拟使用的操作系统平台（`windows`, `macos`, `linux`）

rows.name: `BING_IMPERSONATE`
rows.desc: 是否启用 Bing 的 Chrome TLS 指纹模拟（连续多次返回 0 条时会自动熔断降级为标准 HTTP）

rows.name: `ANUBIS_MAX_POW_DIFFICULTY`
rows.desc: Startpage Anubis 工作量证明（PoW）难度上限，超限时自动跳过或走降级策略

rows.name: `DIRECT_FIRST_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS`
rows.desc: 直连优先策略探测超时时间（毫秒）

rows.name: `FETCH_WEB_INSECURE_TLS`
rows.desc: 仅对 `fetchWebContent` 关闭 TLS 证书校验（目标站点旧证书链损坏时使用）

rows.name: `GITHUB_README_CDN_FIRST`
rows.desc: 为 `true` 时强制跳过 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 直连探测，优先走 jsDelivr CDN 镜像（国内无代理网络加速，免除 3 秒直连探测等待）

zh.title: 🖥️ 服务模式、并发与会话治理

rows.name: `MODE`
rows.desc: MCP 传输通道：`stdio`（仅标准输入输出）、`http`（仅网络接口）、`both`（同时开启）

rows.name: `PORT`
rows.desc: MCP HTTP/SSE 监听端口（CLI 本地常驻 Daemon 默认使用 `3210`）

rows.name: `MAX_CONCURRENT_SEARCHES`
rows.desc: Daemon 模式下的全局最大并发搜索数（`0` 表示不限制）

rows.name: `MCP_MAX_SESSIONS`
rows.desc: 保留的最大并发会话上限，超限时返回 HTTP 429 保护服务器内存

rows.name: `MCP_SESSION_TTL_MS`
rows.desc: 会话空闲回收时长（默认 30 分钟）

rows.name: `MCP_SESSION_REAPER_MS`
rows.desc: 会话清理器扫描巡检间隔（默认 5 分钟）

rows.name: `LOG_LEVEL`
rows.desc: 日志输出级别：`quiet`（完全静默）、`debug`、`info`、`warn`、`error`

rows.name: `SECURITY_AUDIT`
rows.desc: 是否开启安全审计日志（输出 SSRF 拦截详情与主机头放行记录）

rows.name: `OPEN_WEBSEARCH_ALLOWED_HOSTS`
rows.desc: HTTP 服务允许的 Host 域名白名单（DNS Rebinding 安全防护，逗号分隔）

zh.title: 🧭 CDP 浏览器高级控制（保留 Playwright 旧变量名）

rows.name: `BROWSER_DRIVER`
rows.desc: 浏览器后端：`cdp`（默认，raw CDP）；`playwright` 为旧版逃生口，需要你自行安装 `playwright-core`，不再随包提供

rows.name: `BROWSER_PROFILE`
rows.desc: CDP 设备 profile：`off`、`windows-chrome-8`、`windows-chrome-16`、`macos-chrome-8` 或 `random`。对浏览器会话应用 UA、屏幕/DPR、时区、语言；不会影响 DuckDuckGo/Brave 等纯 HTTP 引擎。

rows.name: `DDG_BROWSER_FALLBACK`
rows.desc: DuckDuckGo 的 HTTP 路径返回 202/CAPTCHA 时，改用 CDP 浏览器请求 HTML 端点；显式设置 `BROWSER_PROFILE` 时使用它，否则使用一致的 `windows-chrome-8` 默认 profile；设为 `0` 关闭。

rows.name: `PLAYWRIGHT_CDP_ENDPOINT`
rows.desc: 远程 Chrome/Edge CDP 调试端点（如 `http://127.0.0.1:9222` 或 `ws://...`）；旧变量名，由 CDP 驱动使用

rows.name: `PLAYWRIGHT_EXECUTABLE_PATH`
rows.desc: **Chromium 系**浏览器可执行文件的绝对路径；自动探测覆盖 Chrome / Edge / Chromium / Brave / Vivaldi / Opera 的标准安装位置，`CHROME_PATH` 与 `BROWSER_PATH` 优先且等价；旧变量名

rows.name: `PLAYWRIGHT_HEADLESS`
rows.desc: 是否无头运行（Windows 下自动使用隐身独立桌面）；旧变量名

rows.name: `PLAYWRIGHT_NAVIGATION_TIMEOUT_MS`
rows.desc: 页面导航硬超时（毫秒）；旧变量名，作用于 CDP 导航

rows.name: `MYWEBSEARCH_DATA_DIR`
rows.desc: 配置文件与持久化 Cookie 的根存储目录

rows.name: `OPEN_WEBSEARCH_RESPONSE_CAP_BYTES`
rows.desc: MCP 工具返回给大模型的最大字符上限，防止超长上下文撑爆模型窗口

rows.name: `MCP_TOOL_SEARCH_NAME`
rows.desc: 自定义搜索工具在 MCP 中的注册名称

rows.name: `MCP_TOOL_FETCH_WEB_NAME`
rows.desc: 自定义正文抓取工具在 MCP 中的注册名称

rows.name: `MCP_TOOL_FETCH_GITHUB_NAME`
rows.desc: 自定义 GitHub/Gitee 内容工具在 MCP 中的注册名称（设为 `fetchGithubReadme` 可保持旧名）
